- region "Synthetic fixture controls":
  - heading "Career Finder synthetic stage verification fixture" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Actual current PhoneApp and styles. Synthetic jobs only. No account or employer API. Link clicks record the destination and stay local.
  - generic "Fixture controls and evidence"
  - text: Scenario
  - combobox "Scenario":
    - 'option "250 matches: local 200-result cap"'
    - 'option "Exactly 200 matches: exhausted" [selected]'
    - 'option "50 retained matches: source timeout"'
    - 'option "250 retained matches: source timeout + local cap"'
    - 'option "50 earlier results: stale board"'
    - 'option "No current results: board unavailable"'
    - 'option "50 retained results: provider data-size limit"'
  - text: Product language
  - combobox "Product language":
    - option "English" [selected]
    - option "العربية"
  - text: GET delay (ms)
  - spinbutton "GET delay (ms)": "250"
  - button "Apply fixture scenario"
  - button "Capture observed evidence"
  - region "Synthetic Saved data controls":
    - heading "Synthetic Saved data" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Only the empty guest workspace on this assigned origin can be seeded. No database is cleared. First seed the Interview record-only item, use the normal product UI to delete it, and observe Clear recovery. Only after jobs and records are empty may you seed the 22-item corpus. Do not enter a real profile, CV or note.
    - button "Seed synthetic Interview record-only item"
    - button "Seed synthetic 22-item stage corpus"
    - status: No synthetic seed has been written by these controls.
    - generic "Synthetic seed manifest"
  - paragraph: For these Saved checks, open Saved without running a search. Searching saves search state and makes this workspace ineligible for another seed. Scenario controls retain the existing synthetic search service; no storage is cleared.
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Scenario:"
    - strong: exhausted
    - text: ". Viewport:"
    - strong: 390 × 844
    - text: ". Product cards:"
    - strong: "0"
    - text: .

  - generic "Observed live-region history (DOM only)"
  - generic "Captured evidence including GET ledger"
